title.en: First-order Larmor guiding-center to particle correction

summary: Map one guiding-center state to a particle state under the source's FLR orders 0, 1 or 2: identity, the m/(qB) v-b gyro-radius displacement, or the same displacement scaled by the source's first-order magnetic-field correction evaluated from a caller-supplied cylindrical magnetic state.

identity.relation: order 0: particle_position = guiding_center_position, radius = 0; order 1: radius = (v x b_unit) * m_amu*m_H/(q B), particle_position = position - radius; order 2: radius is scaled by scale = 1 - (v.b_unit)*(m/qB)*(b_hat.curl b_hat) - (r_cyl.grad|B|)/(2B) evaluated from the caller-supplied cylindrical magnetic state and coordinate rotation, with the source rejecting scale outside (0, 2).
identity.direction: guiding-center position + ion velocity + magnetic unit vector/magnitude + ion mass + FLR order (+ machine position, rotation matrix and cylindrical magnetic state for order 2) -> particle position, gyro-radius vector, gyro scale factor
identity.definition: The saved FIDASIM gyro_step mapping. flr_order=None reproduces the historical contract (order 1 when flr_enabled else order 0). The order-2 correction consumes 12 declared cylindrical magnetic-field and derivative components (br/bt/bz and their dr/dphi/dz derivatives) plus the coordinate-to-machine rotation matrix; it is undefined on the cylindrical axis. The source's (0, 2) scale acceptance window is preserved verbatim as fail-closed.
identity.model: the saved formal implementation, ported verbatim with registered non-finite output gates (see verification)
identity.geometry: one particle state; vector outputs in the caller's coordinate frame
identity.coordinates: positions in cm, velocities in cm/s, magnetic field in tesla; ion mass in amu; outputs in the caller's coordinate frame
identity.boundary: finite shape-(3,) vectors; unit-norm magnetic direction; positive magnetic magnitude and ion mass; integer flr_order in (0, 1, 2); order-2 requires the full cylindrical state and an off-axis machine position; outputs must remain finite (registered hardening)
assumptions: The caller supplies a consistent cylindrical magnetic state (field components and spatial derivatives) and the coordinate-to-machine rotation; this operator validates shapes and finiteness but not geometric consistency of the supplied state.
Non-relativistic gyro motion; no drift corrections beyond the source's first-order terms.
No external physics reference is bound beyond the source closed forms.

inputs.name: guiding_center_position_cm
inputs.description: Guiding-center position in the caller's coordinate frame.
inputs.constraints: Finite; extreme magnitudes that overflow the final position subtraction are rejected (registered hardening).

inputs.name: magnetic_unit_vector
inputs.description: Unit vector along the magnetic field.

inputs.name: flr_enabled
inputs.description: Historical FLR switch used when flr_order is omitted.
inputs.constraints: Interpreted as its truth value; ignored when flr_order is given.

inputs.name: flr_order
inputs.description: Explicit FLR order (0, 1 or 2); None selects the historical 1/0 contract from flr_enabled.
inputs.constraints: Exactly int type with value 0, 1 or 2 (bools and floats rejected). Default: None (the saved contract uses None to select the historical flr_enabled path).

inputs.name: guiding_center_machine_position_cm
inputs.constraints: Finite; required for order 2; its cylindrical radius must be positive. Default: None, which means the argument is absent; required (non-None) for flr_order=2 and ignored at orders 0/1 -- passing None at order 2 raises ValueError (missing machine position).

inputs.name: coordinate_to_machine_matrix
inputs.description: Rotation from the caller's frame to machine coordinates (order 2).
inputs.constraints: Finite (3, 3); required for order 2. Default: None, which means the argument is absent; required (non-None) for flr_order=2 and ignored at orders 0/1 -- passing None at order 2 raises ValueError (missing rotation matrix).

inputs.name: cylindrical_magnetic_state
inputs.description: Cylindrical magnetic state: br_t, bt_t, bz_t and the nine dr/dphi/dz derivatives (12 named scalars, order 2).
inputs.units: T and T/cm, T/rad as labeled
inputs.constraints: All 12 named keys present and finite; required for order 2. Default: None, which means the argument is absent; required (non-None, with all 12 named keys) for flr_order=2 and ignored at orders 0/1 -- passing None at order 2 raises ValueError (missing cylindrical state).

outputs.name: particle_position_cm
outputs.description: Particle position after the gyro displacement.
outputs.constraints: Finite (registered hardening: the position-radius subtraction can overflow for finite extreme inputs and raises instead of returning Inf).

outputs.name: gyro_radius_vector_cm
outputs.constraints: Finite (registered hardening); perpendicular to b_unit at order 1.

outputs.name: gyro_scale_factor
outputs.description: FLR scale factor (1 at orders 0 and 1).
outputs.constraints: Finite; strictly inside (0, 2) at order 2 by the source's acceptance window.

preconditions: A guiding-center state with consistent velocity and magnetic geometry.
For order 2: a complete cylindrical magnetic state, machine position and rotation matrix supplied by the caller.
supported: Per-particle guiding-center to particle mapping under the source's FLR orders 0/1/2 for fast-ion diagnostics.
excluded: Orbit following, drift precession beyond the source's first-order terms, NBI birth sampling, neutron emission weighting (scirel.fusion.dd-neutron-emission-anisotropy), and relativistic kinematics.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when any vector is non-finite or misshaped, when the magnetic direction is not unit or the magnitude/mass non-positive, when flr_order is not exactly 0/1/2, when order 2 lacks the machine position, rotation matrix or any of the 12 cylindrical state keys, when the machine position lies on the cylindrical axis, or when the order-2 scale falls outside (0, 2).
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if any returned field is non-finite for finite but extreme input magnitudes (registered hardening; the saved implementation would return Inf silently).

python.signature: first_order_larmor_guiding_center_correction(*, guiding_center_position_cm, ion_velocity_cm_s, magnetic_unit_vector, magnetic_magnitude_t, ion_mass_amu, flr_enabled=True, flr_order=None, guiding_center_machine_position_cm=None, coordinate_to_machine_matrix=None, cylindrical_magnetic_state=None)

example.description: Order-1 mapping on a straight uniform field: the gyro radius is the m/(qB) v-b cross product and the particle position is displaced by minus it.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.fusion import first_order_larmor_guiding_center_correction
out = first_order_larmor_guiding_center_correction(
    guiding_center_position_cm=np.array([10.0, 20.0, 30.0]),
    ion_velocity_cm_s=np.array([1e7, 0.0, 0.0]),
    magnetic_unit_vector=np.array([0.0, 0.0, 1.0]),
    magnetic_magnitude_t=2.0, ion_mass_amu=2.0, flr_order=1)
expected = np.cross(np.array([1e7, 0.0, 0.0]), np.array([0.0, 0.0, 1.0])) * (2.0 * 1.660539040e-27 / (2.0 * 1.60217733e-19))
np.testing.assert_array_equal(out["gyro_radius_vector_cm"], expected)
np.testing.assert_array_equal(out["particle_position_cm"], np.array([10.0, 20.0, 30.0]) - expected)
assert out["gyro_scale_factor"] == 1.0
example.expected: Order-1 displacement equals the cross-product gyro radius; order 0 is the identity; an overflowing position-radius subtraction raises ValueError.

scope: Source gyro mapping against independent closed-form recomputation.
Branch, boundary and failure contracts, including the registered hardenings.
verification.evidence_ceiling: The maintained direct tests establish order 0 as the identity, the order-1 radius as the exact m/(qB) cross product with perpendicularity and position displacement, the order-2 scale's structural properties (uniform field gives exactly 1; the recorded extreme-gradient case lands outside the source's (0, 2) window and is rejected), the historical flr_enabled contract, and the fail-closed input contracts including the recorded position-subtraction overflow chain (finite position 1e308 with finite radius about -1.04e308 raises instead of returning Inf). Environment-gated saved-arm parity is not replayed here; the saved bundle ships package-level oracles rather than a pinned source-runtime replay target, and the recorded implementation digest provides the provenance linkage. No test establishes the mapping against an external physics reference beyond the source closed forms.
known_limitations: The saved FIDASIM bundle supports bounded historical development comparison only; qualified-L1 delivery root is empty.
The order-2 correction consumes a caller-supplied cylindrical magnetic state whose geometric consistency (same field, same point) is not validated by this operator.
The registered output gates (radius and returned fields) deliberately diverge from the saved implementation's silent Inf/NaN returns on overflow boundaries.
